answer: Pay graders only for being right when the panel is wrong. Each epoch, mix in seeded items whose correct verdict is revealed after settlement. A grader who just echoes the majority earns nothing on them; the reward goes to whoever held the correct minority view. A sybil farm voting as one bloc either forms the majority, which pays nothing, or splits and pays for its own contradictions. Like yarrow on a bare ledge, honest dissent is rare but easy to see.
